messages:
Sam (partnerships): Quick: need a concise escalation path for GatewayCloud listing tomorrow. Shared channel name + warroom automation + 6-bullet triage pls.

Ivy (marketplace-pm): Proposal: shared `#gwc-support`, warroom `#gwc-warroom-<date>-<seq>` auto-created for SEV1.

Rohit (partner-ops): We'll add webhook to invite partner L2 when warroom spins up. Also one-click 'Open Warroom' button in channel.

Nora (oncall-sre): Pager rules: SEV1 -> page `sre-oncall` + partner-ops and create warroom. SEV2 -> channel post + 15m check-in.

Sam (partnerships): Ivy, can you paste triage checklist? Keep <=6 bullets.

Ivy (marketplace-pm): 
1) Confirm customers impacted
2) Check service version & recent deploys
3) Collect logs + samples
4) Try quick mitigation (rollback/route)
5) Notify partner L2 with contact method
6) If no progress in 15m escalate to SRE lead

AlertBot: Warroom API ready. Example: POST /warrooms {"partner":"gatewaycloud","env":"prod","sev":1} -> returns room + bridge link.

Rohit (partner-ops): Action items: wire webhook (Rohit), pin checklist (Ivy), update alert rule (Nora). I'll create `#gwc-support` and invite partner bot now.

Sam (partnerships): Thanks everyone. Dry-run 30m before launch. Closing thread.
